currentQa.scope: Preuves finales importées avec leurs dates et empreintes. Les tests du jeu ne sont pas présentés comme exécutés par le builder du classeur.

observations: La Synthèse affiche 54 combattants, 540 techniques, 25 arènes, 477 costumes et 3 308 lignes Production, avec les réserves de finition visibles.
La vue QA 16 montre les 431 tests datés et les preuves d’intégrité, puis le statut navigateur Non exécuté ; l’absence de tentative courante et le blocage Barnoir historique sont lisibles en entier.

visualReview.scope: All 50 original workbook views were actually inspected across the two stated review scopes. Fourteen root diagnostic arrangements aid reading of the same source pixels and do not add views. The six baseline images retain their prior reviewed provenance; no new baseline inspection is claimed here. No desktop Excel, browser or game test is implied by this visual review.

baselineVisualReview.method: Reused unchanged PNGs from the accepted final review of this exact installed XLSX. All six were actually inspected during that prior review; no fresh rendering or fresh visual inspection is claimed here. They remain available for side-by-side comparison during the new final review.

limitations: The update authored and checked the workbook, all native cells, all ten tables, all forty-two formulas and the fifty-five individual drawing slots.
Runtime QA and Canvas results retain the dates, versions and scopes of the final frozen generation wave.
No desktop Excel session, physical-device test, full animation cycle or scene-by-scene canonical approval is claimed.
The published fields in costume coverage denote active local files; GitHub publication is recorded separately.
